page.overview:
Who is Bantor TFP?

Bantor is a Fuzor... or at least he is after Ratchet added some tiger attributes to his mandrill beast mode.

While recovering from a medically-induced stasis, Ratchet drunkenly recalled performing upgrades on Bantor that involved "putting a tiger in his tank".
